paired_sequence_gate.protocol:
Full 22-query control with two identical baselines and one JIT candidate.

12 balanced rounds, all six arm orders twice; five timed full sequences after
two warmups per process. Keyten has 32 workers; the full-result checker has one
Polars thread. Gate requires A/A and both candidate comparisons to pass the
unchanged combined >2 ms and >5% per-query regression threshold.

board_run.host_condition: polling idle; C1/C2 disabled for all arms; restored by supervisor
board_run.methodology:
Run a gated, isolated Keyten-only board refresh using retained competitors.

The paired gate uses five sequences per process; the board retains its existing
12 fresh-process samples/two warmups for PDS-H and ClickBench and best-of-three
for TAQ/Tick. They are separate experiments, with separate recorded protocols.

taq.protocol:
Twelve alternating baseline/candidate pairs of the unchanged full TAQ sequence.

Uses the board's original three evaluations/query and minimum-of-three statistic.
Full-output correctness is a prerequisite from both completed board captures;
timing processes retain the original harness without extra result serialization.
All 53 query deltas are reviewed at the unchanged combined >2ms and >5% threshold.
This follow-up does not replace the original single-sitting Q35 review flag.

disposition: Accepted under the recorded polling-idle condition. Original board Q35 flag and original-host-condition rejected JIT gates are retained.
